text:
Elena V.: Quick thread for the Crestline case study + launch plan. Interview went well this AM. Need to lock quote language and any embargo constraints before we draft social.

Elena V.: Draft quote: "Crestline cut inference costs by ~35% and saw a consistent 20% drop in 95th-percentile latency after migrating to Redwood." Feedback?

Jordan K.: Love it. Two asks: 1) change "cut" -> "reduced" (tone) 2) specify time window for the benchmark (e.g., "last quarter" or "steady-state June"). Also suggest a short customer pull-quote for the hero image (one line).

Luis M.: Legal flagged that Crestline prefers case mentions to be non-promotional in paid channels; they allowed organic and webinar only. We need a signed media release that includes paid-ad restrictions. Also ask analytics team for the raw dashboard export for the 35% cost number.

Rhea P.: I'll coordinate the inbound lead routing. Recommend tagging HubSpot campaign: crestline-launch-q2. Do we want a dedicated AE assignment or round-robin? 

Elena V.: They requested a named AE in initial follow-up. Jordan, can you confirm which rep?

Jordan K.: Put it to Maia K. for initial outreach, then round-robin after demo request. I'll update the HubSpot mapping once Rhea creates the campaign.

Rhea P.: I'll create campaign and pre-fill AE mapping. Also creating the landing page draft. Need final headline and CTA by Thursday COB.

Luis M.: Legal note: remove absolute words like "always" or "guarantee". Also add an attribution line: "based on internal benchmarking provided by Crestline and Redwood (May 2025)". We need that to avoid audit questions.

Elena V.: Updated quote per Jordan + legal: "Crestline reduced inference costs by approximately 35% and observed a 20% reduction in 95th-percentile latency during steady-state runs in May 2025." Added attribution line and softened language.

Jordan K.: That reads well. For hero pull-quote: "Redwood let us scale inference without blowing up costs." — keep short and punchy.

Rhea P.: Webinar: propose 25m demo, 10m customer spotlight, 15m live Q&A. Crestline can do a short case talk. Requested speaker: Crestline SRE lead + Redwood PM. Need slide assets and speaker bios by Wednesday 10am PT.

Elena V.: Can Crestline share an anonymized trace or screenshot for the blog? They prefer screenshots with no internal hostnames. Luis, is that okay for legal?

Luis M.: Fine if sanitized. Please get written confirmation from Crestline on what can be redacted and that we have their sign-off on the final image.

Jordan K.: Social drafts: three variants — (1) product angle, (2) cost-savings angle, (3) webinar invite. Avoid Crestline's logo in paid ads per their restriction. I'll mark paid content as logo-free.

Rhea P.: I'll set inbound workflow: registration -> CTA maps to HubSpot campaign crestline-launch-q2 -> AE Maia K assigned -> tag: crestline-launch-q2. Also adding source UTM params for tracking.

ops-bot: Reminder: attach signed media release before publish or the publish job will fail.

Elena V.: Checklist to close (please add reactions when done):
- [ ] Signed media release in Drive
- [ ] Benchmark export uploaded and linked
- [ ] Final quote approved by product + legal
- [ ] Landing page copy + CTA approved
- [ ] Slides + bios submitted (Wed 10am PT)
- [ ] HubSpot campaign + AE mapping live
- [ ] Social copy + paid restrictions confirmed

Jordan K.: I'll draft the three social variants and drop in the marketing-drafts channel by EOD tomorrow.

Luis M.: I'll follow up with Crestline legal for the signed release and confirm exact wording for the paid-ad exclusion.

Rhea P.: Campaign created (crestline-launch-q2). Will add stakeholders once landing page is live.

Elena V.: Thanks team — aiming to go live next Friday. I'll post the final files once legal signs off. :rocket:
